anomalies.expected: The specification requires R4 = 1 kΩ as a series resistor from /PWM2 to J8 pin 3, matching R3 on channel 1, so each PWM servo header receives a DC-coupled, 1 kΩ-buffered GPIO signal.

evidence.quote: R3, R4 | 1k each | Series resistors from the PWM1/PWM2 GPIO nets to J3 pin 3 / J8 pin 3 respectively.

anomalies.impact: In PWM mode, channel 2 is not correctly driven: the servo signal is AC-coupled through a large capacitor instead of DC-coupled through 1 kΩ, so the SG90-class servo may not receive valid PWM levels and channel 2 will likely be nonfunctional or erratic. If the PWM jumpers are populated while serial mode is selected, C6 also ties the shared serial bus to the PWM2 node, potentially loading or interfering with the bus.

parsed.summary: The design files show a clear anomaly on the PWM2 servo signal path: the specified series resistor R4 is absent and has been replaced by a 100 µF capacitor C6 between /PWM2 and J8 pin 3, which would prevent correct PWM operation of channel 2.
